messages.subject: [Sorvi-admin] Digital advocacy project
messages.body_plain:
Dear Engine Room admins,

I recently learned about your project aimed to map initiatives for digital
advocacy. At https://www.theengineroom.org/services/#support you ask to
provide information on related, complementary projects.

In the Finnish Louhos project (http://louhos.github.com/en), we are working
to collect comprehensive software libraries to analyze society and
decision-making processes based on publicly available data resources. Our
project aims to combine latest advances in data analysis to up-to-date data
resources and to provide freely available analytical research tools for
academics, NGOs, journalists, citizens, and other target groups. I felt
that this project is within the scope of your initiative, therefore wanted
to follow your request and send a note. We will be happy to provide further
information of the project, if you wish.

kind regards
Leo Lahti, D.Sc.
Louhos, Finland


--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Services for Support Organizations

Organizations and initiatives dedicated to supporting digital advocacy
increasingly work with citizens in wildly varying contexts, making it more
difficult to maximize reach and impact in the context of a rapidly changing
media environment. The engine room provides empirical frameworks and
engagement processes to address these challenges.

This may include:

   Research on capacity gaps in target stakeholder groups;
   Identification of stakeholders, trainees and counterparts;
   Development and implementation of tailored frameworks for monitoring and
evaluation;
   Data-based analysis to develop strategies for follow-up programming and
lasting impact

messages.subject: [Sorvi-admin] Digital advocacy project
messages.body_plain:
Dear Susannah,

thanks for the response - great to hear about your related plans!

Our site and tool  documentation are mostly in Finnish, as we believe in
localization in the open government data context. The documentation is at
the moment lagging a bit behind tool development due to the
volunteer-driven nature of our project. But we are right now working to
improve the documentation. The current tool documentation is available
through the wiki at (google translate may help):
https://github.com/louhos/soRvi/wiki/Data and the source code for each tool
can be found from the GitHub account at https://github.com/louhos/soRvi And
(preliminary) installation instructions for the sorvi R library at:
http://louhos.github.com/sorvi/asennus.html

Most of these tools concern Finnish open government data and may not be as
such directly applicable for your purposes. But they could provide a
starting point. We would like to promote & network similar initiatives in
other countries as there would certainly be overlap that can be utilized.

It would be great to discuss together related issues. At least some of us
would be available for a phone/skype meeting at least on July 20-24, August
7, and then August 20 onwards (summer holidays now ongoing here in Finland,
and many people go off-line). Let us know how these times would match -

best regard,
Leo

The documentation is at the moment lagging a bit behind tool development due to the volunteer-driven nature of our project. But we are right now working to improve the documentation. The current tool documentation is available through the wiki at (google translate may help): https://github.com/louhos/soRvi/wiki/Data and the source code for each tool can be found from the GitHub account at https://github.com/louhos/soRvi And (preliminary) installation instructions for the sorvi R library at: http://louhos.github.com/sorvi/asennus.html

> Leo
> 
>

> 
> Susannah
